Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.betaNotice: Beta notice: JNJGO Resume is currently in beta. This privacy policy is a working draft and will be updated before general availability.
Privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address (via Google OAuth), career history, salary expectations, and job preferences. We also collect usage data such as pages visited and features used.
Privacy.s2Item1: To provide and improve the AI resume building service
Privacy.s2Item2: To connect candidates with recruiters (only when you opt in by publishing your profile)
Privacy.s2Item4: To analyze usage patterns and improve the product
Privacy.s3Body: We do not sell your personal data. Your private profile information (salary expectations, deal-breakers, contact details) is only visible to approved recruiters when you explicitly publish your profile. Resume content shared via export links is your responsibility.
Privacy.s4Body: Your interview conversations and career information are processed by Google's Gemini AI to generate resume content. Please review Google's privacy policy for how your data is handled during AI processing. We do not use your data to train our own AI models.
Privacy.s5Body: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time by contacting us. During the beta period, we may reset or delete data as part of maintenance. We will provide advance notice where possible.
Privacy.s6Body: We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and secure credential storage. However, no system is 100% secure. During the beta period, security features are still being hardened.
Privacy.s7Body: For privacy-related questions, please contact us at

HowToTest.title: How to test JNJGO Resume
HowToTest.subtitle: Select your role below and follow the 3-step guide. The whole flow takes about 10–15 minutes.
HowToTest.betaDisclaimerTitle: Beta disclaimer: This is an early version of the product.
HowToTest.betaItem1: Some features are still being built (job board, LinkedIn/GitHub login)
HowToTest.betaItem2: Data may be reset during the beta period
HowToTest.betaItem3: AI-generated content may occasionally be inaccurate — always review before using
HowToTest.cStep1Desc: Go to the home page and click "Sign in with Google". After signing in, select the Candidate role. You'll land on your dashboard automatically.
HowToTest.cStep1Tip2: No invite code required during beta
HowToTest.cStep2Desc: From the dashboard, click "New Resume". Optionally paste an existing resume or LinkedIn profile text to give the AI context. Then answer the AI's interview questions about your career history.
HowToTest.cStep2Tip1: Pasting an existing resume gives faster, higher-quality results
HowToTest.cStep2Tip2: Answer at least 5–6 interview questions for best output
HowToTest.cStep2Tip3: The AI will flag any employment gaps — answer honestly to proceed
HowToTest.cStep2Tip4: Once the resume scores 80+, it's ready to export
HowToTest.cStep3Desc: Use the Export tab to copy a platform-ready resume for LinkedIn or BizReach. To get contacted by recruiters, go to Profile → Private Profile and toggle "Publish profile" to make your profile visible.
HowToTest.cStep3Tip1: Your profile is private (draft) by default — you must manually publish it
HowToTest.cStep3Tip2: Once published, approved recruiters can find and message you
HowToTest.cStep3Tip3: You'll receive scout messages in your Messages inbox
HowToTest.rStep1Desc: Go to the home page and click "Sign in as a Recruiter". After signing in with Google, select the Recruiter role and fill in your company name, job title, and recruiter type (in-house or agency).
HowToTest.rStep1Tip1: You must sign in with a corporate work email — personal providers (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, etc.) are not accepted
HowToTest.rStep1Tip2: Sign-in is via Google only — your work email must be linked to a Google account (Google Workspace, or a Google account created with your work email)
HowToTest.rStep2Desc: Recruiter accounts require manual approval to protect candidate privacy. After submitting your onboarding, your account will be in a pending state.
HowToTest.rStep2Tip1: Approval is done manually — usually within 24 hours
HowToTest.rStep2Tip2: To get approved faster, email us at dev@kerofi.net
HowToTest.rStep2Tip3: You'll be able to sign in and access the dashboard once approved
HowToTest.rStep3Desc: Once approved, you'll have access to the Recruiter Dashboard. Search and filter candidates by skills, salary range, job intent, and availability. Open a candidate's profile to view their full details, save them, or send a direct scout message.
HowToTest.rStep3Tip1: Only candidates who have published their profile are visible
HowToTest.rStep3Tip2: You can save candidates to review later
HowToTest.rStep3Tip3: Candidates receive your messages in their inbox and can reply
HowToTest.limit1: GitHub and LinkedIn sign-in are not yet available (Google only)
HowToTest.limit2: Job board / job matching is coming soon
HowToTest.limit3: Employment gap detection may occasionally ask the same question twice
HowToTest.limit4: Recruiter sign-in requires a corporate Google Workspace email — personal addresses (Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook, etc.) are blocked
HowToTest.limit5: Recruiter accounts require manual approval — email dev@kerofi.net to expedite
